purpose: Define the only machine-ingestible handoff from a specialist semantic executor back to the deterministic N12 structural-analysis cycle.

non_pass_rules.RESIDUAL: Do not promote the work item. Persist the smallest unresolved claim and keep the item in RESIDUAL.
non_pass_rules.BLOCKED: Do not promote. Mark the item BLOCKED and identify the missing input/dependency in residuals.
non_pass_rules.CONFLICT: Do not promote. Mark the item BLOCKED, record CONFLICT_STOP in state and reopen only the smallest conflicting claim.

forbidden: multiple work items in one result
changing the selected queue item by agent preference
copying sections or beams from another storey
canonical promotion with missing audit evidence
